# Dobot CR10 TCP/IP Protocol v4

*Generated by researcher agent (qwen2.5:72b) — 2026-02-26*

## Connection Ports

| Port | Purpose | Mode |
|------|---------|------|
| 29999 | Dashboard/general control | Command-response |
| 30003 | Real-time joint control | Command-response |
| 30004 | Real-time feedback stream | Continuous 100hz |

## Port 29999 — Dashboard Commands

General control: start/stop robot, load programs, system info.

```
get_robot_status\n
```

Response (JSON):
```json
{
  "robot_status": {
    "connected": true,
    "running": false,
    "error_code": 0,
    "program_state": "stopped"
  }
}
```

## Port 30003 — Joint Control

Real-time joint control commands.

```
set_joint_angles <J1> <J2> <J3> <J4> <J5> <J6>\n
```
- Joint angles in degrees
- Response: `OK`

## Port 30004 — Real-Time Feedback

Continuous JSON stream at 100hz:

```json
{
  "joint_positions": [0.0, 90.0, -90.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
  "joint_velocities": [0.0, 180.0, 180.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
  "error_code": 0,
  "program_state": "running"
}
```

## Error Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 0 | No error |
| 1 | Joint limit exceeded |
| 2 | Payload too heavy |
| 3 | Communication failure |
| 4 | Hardware fault |

## Connection Example

```python
import socket

sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
sock.connect(('192.168.5.1', 29999))
sock.sendall(b"get_robot_status\n")
response = sock.recv(1024).decode('utf-8')
sock.close()
```

## Notes
- Default robot IP: 192.168.5.1
- Commands are case-sensitive
- Newline terminated
- Auto-reconnect recommended for production use
